slide_text: Is 100% training accuracy a good thing?

fragments.text: Not necessarily. The tree has memorized the training data including its noise and outliers.
This is overfitting . Solutions: max_depth: stop splitting after N levels min_samples: don t split groups smaller than K Random Forest: build many trees on random subsets, take a vote
